FILE: app/src/main/java/com/pallas/launcher/data/repository/AppRepository.kt

package com.pallas.launcher.data.repository

import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.LauncherApps
import android.content.pm.ShortcutInfo
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Process
import android.os.UserHandle
import android.os.UserManager
import android.provider.Settings
import android.widget.Toast
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.text.Collator
import java.util.Locale

class AppRepository(
    private val context: Context,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope
) {
    private val launcherApps: LauncherApps by lazy {
        context.getSystemService(Context.LAUNCHER_APPS_SERVICE) as LauncherApps
    }
    private val userManager: UserManager by lazy {
        context.getSystemService(Context.USER_SERVICE) as UserManager
    }

    private val _installedApps = MutableStateFlow<List<AppItem>>(emptyList())
    val installedApps: StateFlow<List<AppItem>> = _installedApps.asStateFlow()

    private val _isLoaded = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isLoaded: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isLoaded.asStateFlow()

    private var launcherAppsCallback: LauncherApps.Callback? = null
    private var reloadJob: Job? = null

    init {
        registerLauncherCallback()
        reloadApps()
    }

    private fun registerLauncherCallback() {
        val callback = object : LauncherApps.Callback() {
            override fun onPackageRemoved(packageName: String, user: UserHandle) {
                reloadApps()
            }

            override fun onPackageAdded(packageName: String, user: UserHandle) {
                reloadApps()
            }

            override fun onPackageChanged(packageName: String, user: UserHandle) {
                reloadApps()
            }

            override fun onPackagesAvailable(
                packageNames: Array<out String>,
                user: UserHandle,
                replacing: Boolean
            ) {
                reloadApps()
            }

            override fun onPackagesUnavailable(
                packageNames: Array<out String>,
                user: UserHandle,
                replacing: Boolean
            ) {
                reloadApps()
            }

            override fun onShortcutsChanged(
                packageName: String,
                shortcuts: MutableList<ShortcutInfo>,
                user: UserHandle
            ) {
                // no-op for app list
            }
        }
        launcherApps.registerCallback(callback)
        launcherAppsCallback = callback
    }

    fun unregister() {
        launcherAppsCallback?.let { launcherApps.unregisterCallback(it) }
        launcherAppsCallback = null
    }

    fun reloadApps() {
        reloadJob?.cancel()
        reloadJob = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val apps = queryInstalledApps()
            _installedApps.value = apps
            _isLoaded.value = true
        }
    }

    private suspend fun queryInstalledApps(): List<AppItem> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val appList = mutableListOf<AppItem>()
        val collator = Collator.getInstance(Locale.getDefault())

        try {
            val profiles = userManager.userProfiles
            for (profile in profiles) {
                val activityList = launcherApps.getActivityList(null, profile)
                for (activity in activityList) {
                    val pkg = activity.applicationInfo.packageName
                    // Skip our own launcher package
                    if (pkg == context.packageName) continue

                    val label = activity.label?.toString() ?: pkg
                    val serial = userManager.getSerialNumberForUser(profile)
                    val appItem = AppItem(
                        packageName = pkg,
                        activityName = activity.componentName.className,
                        label = label,
                        userHandle = profile,
                        userSerialNumber = serial,
                        installTime = activity.firstInstallTime
                    )
                    appList.add(appItem)
                }
            }
            appList.sortWith(compareBy(collator) { it.label })
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        appList
    }

    fun launchApp(packageName: String, activityName: String?, userHandle: UserHandle? = null) {
        val targetUser = userHandle ?: Process.myUserHandle()
        val activityList = try {
            launcherApps.getActivityList(packageName, targetUser)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }

        val targetComponent = if (!activityName.isNullOrBlank() && activityList.any { it.componentName.className == activityName }) {
            ComponentName(packageName, activityName)
        } else if (activityList.isNotEmpty()) {
            activityList.first().componentName
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "App not found", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        try {
            val opts = android.app.ActivityOptions.makeCustomAnimation(context, android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out).toBundle()
            launcherApps.startMainActivity(targetComponent, targetUser, null, opts)
        } catch (e: SecurityException) {
            try {
                val opts = android.app.ActivityOptions.makeCustomAnimation(context, android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out).toBundle()
                launcherApps.startMainActivity(targetComponent, Process.myUserHandle(), null, opts)
            } catch (ex: Exception) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Unable to launch app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Unable to launch app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    fun openAppInfo(packageName: String, activityName: String? = null, userHandle: UserHandle? = null) {
        try {
            val targetUser = userHandle ?: Process.myUserHandle()
            val component = if (activityName != null) ComponentName(packageName, activityName) else ComponentName(packageName, "")
            launcherApps.startAppDetailsActivity(component, targetUser, null, null)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // Fallback
            try {
                val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                    data = Uri.parse("package:$packageName")
                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                }
                context.startActivity(intent)
            } catch (ex: Exception) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Cannot open app info", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    fun getAppShortcuts(packageName: String, userHandle: UserHandle? = null): List<ShortcutInfo> {
        val targetUser = userHandle ?: Process.myUserHandle()
        return try {
            if (launcherApps.hasShortcutHostPermission()) {
                val query = LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery().apply {
                    setPackage(packageName)
                    setQueryFlags(
                        LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC or
                                LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_PINNED or
                                LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_MANIFEST
                    )
                }
                launcherApps.getShortcuts(query, targetUser) ?: emptyList()
            } else {
                emptyList()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }
    }
}

============================================================

package com.pallas.launcher.data.repository

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import kotlin.math.pow

class AppUsageTracker(context: Context) {

    private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("pallas_app_usage", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun recordAppLaunch(packageName: String) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val count = prefs.getInt("${packageName}_count", 0)
        prefs.edit()
            .putInt("${packageName}_count", count + 1)
            .putLong("${packageName}_last_used", now)
            .apply()
    }

    fun getAppLaunchCount(packageName: String): Int {
        return prefs.getInt("${packageName}_count", 0)
    }

    fun getUsageBonus(packageName: String): Double {
        val count = getAppLaunchCount(packageName)
        val lastUsed = prefs.getLong("${packageName}_last_used", 0L)
        if (count == 0 || lastUsed == 0L) return 0.0

        val hoursSinceUse = (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastUsed) / (1000.0 * 3600.0)
        // Decay factor: half-life around 48 hours
        val recencyFactor = 0.5.pow(hoursSinceUse / 48.0)

        // Frequency bonus decayed by recency
        val bonus = minOf(count * 15.0, 100.0) * recencyFactor + (if (hoursSinceUse < 24.0) 50.0 else 0.0)
        return minOf(bonus, 150.0)
    }

    fun getRecentApps(limit: Int = 6): List<String> {
        val all = prefs.all
        val lastUsedMap = mutableMapOf<String, Long>()
        for ((key, value) in all) {
            if (key.endsWith("_last_used") && value is Long) {
                val pkg = key.removeSuffix("_last_used")
                lastUsedMap[pkg] = value
            }
        }
        return lastUsedMap.entries
            .sortedByDescending { it.value }
            .take(limit)
            .map { it.key }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/pallas/launcher/data/repository/ScreenRepository.kt

package com.pallas.launcher.data.repository

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.os.UserManager
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppItem
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.HomeScreen
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ScreenApp
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.util.UUID

class ScreenRepository(
    private val context: Context
) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("pallas_screens", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    private val userManager = context.getSystemService(Context.USER_SERVICE) as? UserManager

    private val _screens = MutableStateFlow<List<HomeScreen>>(loadScreens())
    val screens: StateFlow<List<HomeScreen>> = _screens.asStateFlow()

    private fun loadScreens(): List<HomeScreen> {
        val rawJson = prefs.getString(KEY_SCREENS, null)
        if (rawJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return listOf(
                HomeScreen(
                    id = "home_main",
                    name = "Home",
                    contextTag = "General",
                    apps = emptyList()
                )
            )
        }

        val result = mutableListOf<HomeScreen>()
        try {
            val jsonArray = JSONArray(rawJson)
            for (i in 0 until jsonArray.length()) {
                val screenObj = jsonArray.getJSONObject(i)
                val id = screenObj.optString("id", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                val name = screenObj.optString("name", "Screen ${i + 1}")
                val contextTag = if (screenObj.has("contextTag")) screenObj.getString("contextTag") else null
                val appsArray = screenObj.optJSONArray("apps") ?: JSONArray()
                val apps = mutableListOf<ScreenApp>()
                for (j in 0 until appsArray.length()) {
                    val appObj = appsArray.getJSONObject(j)
                    val pkg = appObj.optString("packageName")
                    val activity = appObj.optString("activityName")
                    val serial = appObj.optLong("userSerialNumber", 0L)
                    val uniqueKey = appObj.optString("uniqueKey").ifBlank { "$pkg/$activity#$serial" }
                    val customLabel = if (appObj.has("customLabel")) appObj.getString("customLabel") else null
                    val defaultLabel = appObj.optString("defaultLabel", "")
                    val handle = userManager?.getUserForSerialNumber(serial)

                    if (pkg.isNotBlank()) {
                        apps.add(
                            ScreenApp(
                                uniqueKey = uniqueKey,
                                packageName = pkg,
                                activityName = activity,
                                customLabel = customLabel,
                                defaultLabel = defaultLabel,
                                userSerialNumber = serial,
                                userHandle = handle
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
                result.add(HomeScreen(id = id, name = name, contextTag = contextTag, apps = apps))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        return if (result.isEmpty()) {
            listOf(HomeScreen(id = "home_main", name = "Home", contextTag = "General", apps = emptyList()))
        } else {
            result
        }
    }

    private fun saveScreens(screenList: List<HomeScreen>) {
        try {
            val jsonArray = JSONArray()
            for (screen in screenList) {
                val screenObj = JSONObject()
                screenObj.put("id", screen.id)
                screenObj.put("name", screen.name)
                if (screen.contextTag != null) {
                    screenObj.put("contextTag", screen.contextTag)
                }
                val appsArray = JSONArray()
                for (app in screen.apps) {
                    val appObj = JSONObject()
                    appObj.put("uniqueKey", app.uniqueKey)
                    appObj.put("packageName", app.packageName)
                    appObj.put("activityName", app.activityName)
                    appObj.put("userSerialNumber", app.userSerialNumber)
                    if (app.customLabel != null) {
                        appObj.put("customLabel", app.customLabel)
                    }
                    appObj.put("defaultLabel", app.defaultLabel)
                    appsArray.put(appObj)
                }
                screenObj.put("apps", appsArray)
                jsonArray.put(screenObj)
            }
            prefs.edit().putString(KEY_SCREENS, jsonArray.toString()).apply()
            _screens.value = screenList
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    fun initDefaultScreenWithApps(installedApps: List<AppItem>) {
        if (prefs.getBoolean("key_screens_seeded", false)) return
        prefs.edit().putBoolean("key_screens_seeded", true).apply()
    }

    fun addScreen(name: String, contextTag: String? = null) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        current.add(
            HomeScreen(
                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                name = name,
                contextTag = contextTag,
                apps = emptyList()
            )
        )
        saveScreens(current)
    }

    fun renameScreen(screenId: String, newName: String, newContextTag: String? = null) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        val index = current.indexOfFirst { it.id == screenId }
        if (index != -1) {
            current[index] = current[index].copy(
                name = newName.trim(),
                contextTag = newContextTag?.trim()?.ifBlank { null }
            )
            saveScreens(current)
        }
    }

    fun moveScreen(fromIndex: Int, toIndex: Int) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        if (fromIndex in current.indices && toIndex in current.indices && fromIndex != toIndex) {
            val item = current.removeAt(fromIndex)
            current.add(toIndex, item)
            saveScreens(current)
        }
    }

    fun removeScreen(screenId: String) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        if (current.size <= 1) return
        current.removeAll { it.id == screenId }
        saveScreens(current)
    }

    fun addAppToScreen(screenId: String, appItem: AppItem, customLabel: String? = null) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        val index = current.indexOfFirst { it.id == screenId }
        if (index != -1) {
            val screen = current[index]
            val exists = screen.apps.any { it.uniqueKey == appItem.uniqueKey }
            if (!exists) {
                val newApp = ScreenApp(
                    uniqueKey = appItem.uniqueKey,
                    packageName = appItem.packageName,
                    activityName = appItem.activityName,
                    customLabel = customLabel,
                    defaultLabel = appItem.label,
                    userSerialNumber = appItem.userSerialNumber,
                    userHandle = appItem.userHandle
                )
                current[index] = screen.copy(apps = screen.apps + newApp)
                saveScreens(current)
            }
        }
    }

    fun removeAppFromScreen(screenId: String, uniqueKey: String) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        val index = current.indexOfFirst { it.id == screenId }
        if (index != -1) {
            val screen = current[index]
            current[index] = screen.copy(apps = screen.apps.filterNot { it.uniqueKey == uniqueKey || it.packageName == uniqueKey })
            saveScreens(current)
        }
    }

    fun updateAppLabelAcrossScreens(uniqueKey: String, newLabel: String) {
        val current = _screens.value.map { screen ->
            val updatedApps = screen.apps.map { app ->
                if (app.uniqueKey == uniqueKey || app.packageName == uniqueKey) {
                    app.copy(customLabel = newLabel.ifBlank { null })
                } else {
                    app
                }
            }
            screen.copy(apps = updatedApps)
        }
        saveScreens(current)
    }

    fun updateAppLabel(screenId: String, uniqueKey: String, newLabel: String) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        val index = current.indexOfFirst { it.id == screenId }
        if (index != -1) {
            val screen = current[index]
            val updatedApps = screen.apps.map { app ->
                if (app.uniqueKey == uniqueKey || app.packageName == uniqueKey) {
                    app.copy(customLabel = newLabel.ifBlank { null })
                } else {
                    app
                }
            }
            current[index] = screen.copy(apps = updatedApps)
            saveScreens(current)
        }
    }

    fun reorderApps(screenId: String, reordered: List<ScreenApp>) {
        val current = _screens.value.toMutableList()
        val index = current.indexOfFirst { it.id == screenId }
        if (index != -1) {
            current[index] = current[index].copy(apps = reordered)
            saveScreens(current)
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val KEY_SCREENS = "key_screens_json"
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.data.repository

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsHorizontalAlignment
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsVerticalPosition
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockHorizontalAlignment
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockVerticalPosition
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.GestureAction
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.LauncherSettings
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.TextAlignmentOption
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import org.json.JSONObject

class SettingsRepository(
    private val context: Context
) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("pallas_settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    private val _settings = MutableStateFlow(loadSettings())
    val settings: StateFlow<LauncherSettings> = _settings.asStateFlow()


    private inline fun <reified T : Enum<T>> enumOrDefault(value: String?, default: T): T {
        if (value == null) return default
        return try {
            java.lang.Enum.valueOf(T::class.java, value)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            default
        }
    }

    private fun loadSettings(): LauncherSettings {
        val themeModeStr = prefs.getString(KEY_THEME_MODE, ThemeMode.DARK.name)
        val themeMode = enumOrDefault(prefs.getString(KEY_THEME_MODE, null), ThemeMode.DARK)

        val showScrim = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_WALLPAPER_SCRIM, false)
        val hideStatusBar = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_HIDE_STATUS_BAR, false)

        val alignmentStr = prefs.getString(KEY_ALIGNMENT, TextAlignmentOption.RIGHT.name)
        val alignment = try {
            TextAlignmentOption.valueOf(alignmentStr ?: TextAlignmentOption.RIGHT.name)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            TextAlignmentOption.RIGHT
        }

        val clockVertStr = prefs.getString(KEY_CLOCK_VERT, ClockVerticalPosition.TOP.name)
        val clockVert = enumOrDefault(prefs.getString(KEY_CLOCK_VERT, null), ClockVerticalPosition.TOP)

        val clockHorizStr = prefs.getString(KEY_CLOCK_HORIZ, ClockHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT.name)
        val clockHoriz = try {
            ClockHorizontalAlignment.valueOf(clockHorizStr ?: ClockHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT.name)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            ClockHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT
        }

        val appsVertStr = prefs.getString(KEY_APPS_VERT, AppsVerticalPosition.BOTTOM.name)
        val appsVert = enumOrDefault(prefs.getString(KEY_APPS_VERT, null), AppsVerticalPosition.BOTTOM)

        val appsHorizStr = prefs.getString(KEY_APPS_HORIZ, AppsHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT.name)
        val appsHoriz = try {
            AppsHorizontalAlignment.valueOf(appsHorizStr ?: AppsHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT.name)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            AppsHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT
        }

        val is24Hour = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_24_HOUR, false)
        val showDate = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SHOW_DATE, true)
        val showBattery = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SHOW_BATTERY, true)

        val swipeLeftStr = prefs.getString(KEY_SWIPE_LEFT, "camera") ?: "camera"
        val swipeRightStr = prefs.getString(KEY_SWIPE_RIGHT, "dialer") ?: "dialer"
        val swipeUpStr = prefs.getString(KEY_SWIPE_UP, "search") ?: "search"
        val swipeDownStr = prefs.getString(KEY_SWIPE_DOWN, "notifications") ?: "notifications"

        val aliasesJson = prefs.getString(KEY_ALIASES, "{}") ?: "{}"
        val aliases = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
        try {
            val json = JSONObject(aliasesJson)
            val keys = json.keys()
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                val key = keys.next()
                aliases[key] = json.getString(key)
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        // Set default handy aliases if completely empty
        if (aliases.isEmpty()) {
            aliases["wa"] = "whatsapp"
            aliases["calc"] = "calculator"
            aliases["cam"] = "camera"
            aliases["yt"] = "youtube"
        }

        val pinnedContactsSet = prefs.getStringSet(KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS, emptySet()) ?: emptySet()
        val pinnedContactsJson = prefs.getString(KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS_MAP, "{}") ?: "{}"
        val pinnedContactsMap = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
        try {
            val json = JSONObject(pinnedContactsJson)
            val keys = json.keys()
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                val key = keys.next()
                pinnedContactsMap[key] = json.getString(key)
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        val fontScale = prefs.getFloat(KEY_FONT_SCALE, 1.0f)
        val hiddenApps = prefs.getStringSet(KEY_HIDDEN_APPS, emptySet()) ?: emptySet()

        return LauncherSettings(
            themeMode = themeMode,
            showWallpaperScrim = showScrim,
            hideStatusBar = hideStatusBar,
            alignment = alignment,
            clockVerticalPosition = clockVert,
            clockHorizontalAlignment = clockHoriz,
            appsVerticalPosition = appsVert,
            appsHorizontalAlignment = appsHoriz,
            is24HourClock = is24Hour,
            showDate = showDate,
            showBattery = showBattery,
            shortSwipeLeftAction = GestureAction.fromString(swipeLeftStr),
            shortSwipeRightAction = GestureAction.fromString(swipeRightStr),
            swipeUpAction = GestureAction.fromString(swipeUpStr),
            swipeDownAction = GestureAction.fromString(swipeDownStr),
            customAliases = aliases,
            pinnedContacts = pinnedContactsMap,
            appFontScale = fontScale,
            hiddenApps = hiddenApps
        )
    }

    fun updateThemeMode(theme: ThemeMode) {
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_THEME_MODE, theme.name).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(themeMode = theme)
    }

    fun updateWallpaperScrim(scrim: Boolean) {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_WALLPAPER_SCRIM, scrim).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(showWallpaperScrim = scrim)
    }

    fun updateHideStatusBar(hide: Boolean) {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_HIDE_STATUS_BAR, hide).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(hideStatusBar = hide)
    }

    fun updateClockPosition(vertical: ClockVerticalPosition, horizontal: ClockHorizontalAlignment) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString(KEY_CLOCK_VERT, vertical.name)
            .putString(KEY_CLOCK_HORIZ, horizontal.name)
            .apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(
            clockVerticalPosition = vertical,
            clockHorizontalAlignment = horizontal
        )
    }

    fun updateAppsPosition(vertical: AppsVerticalPosition, horizontal: AppsHorizontalAlignment) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString(KEY_APPS_VERT, vertical.name)
            .putString(KEY_APPS_HORIZ, horizontal.name)
            .apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(
            appsVerticalPosition = vertical,
            appsHorizontalAlignment = horizontal
        )
    }

    fun updateAlignment(alignment: TextAlignmentOption) {
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ALIGNMENT, alignment.name).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(alignment = alignment)
    }

    fun update24HourClock(is24Hour: Boolean) {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_24_HOUR, is24Hour).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(is24HourClock = is24Hour)
    }

    fun updateShowDate(show: Boolean) {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_SHOW_DATE, show).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(showDate = show)
    }

    fun updateShowBattery(show: Boolean) {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_SHOW_BATTERY, show).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(showBattery = show)
    }

    fun updateGestureActions(
        swipeLeft: GestureAction? = null,
        swipeRight: GestureAction? = null,
        swipeUp: GestureAction? = null,
        swipeDown: GestureAction? = null
    ) {
        val editor = prefs.edit()
        var current = _settings.value

        swipeLeft?.let {
            editor.putString(KEY_SWIPE_LEFT, GestureAction.toString(it))
            current = current.copy(shortSwipeLeftAction = it)
        }
        swipeRight?.let {
            editor.putString(KEY_SWIPE_RIGHT, GestureAction.toString(it))
            current = current.copy(shortSwipeRightAction = it)
        }
        swipeUp?.let {
            editor.putString(KEY_SWIPE_UP, GestureAction.toString(it))
            current = current.copy(swipeUpAction = it)
        }
        swipeDown?.let {
            editor.putString(KEY_SWIPE_DOWN, GestureAction.toString(it))
            current = current.copy(swipeDownAction = it)
        }

        editor.apply()
        _settings.value = current
    }

    fun setAlias(alias: String, target: String) {
        val current = _settings.value.customAliases.toMutableMap()
        if (target.isBlank()) {
            current.remove(alias.lowercase().trim())
        } else {
            current[alias.lowercase().trim()] = target.trim()
        }
        val json = JSONObject(current as Map<*, *>)
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ALIASES, json.toString()).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(customAliases = current)
    }

    fun removeAlias(alias: String) {
        val current = _settings.value.customAliases.toMutableMap()
        current.remove(alias.lowercase().trim())
        val json = JSONObject(current as Map<*, *>)
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ALIASES, json.toString()).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(customAliases = current)
    }

    fun addPinnedContact(name: String, phoneNumber: String) {
        val trimmedName = name.trim()
        val trimmedNumber = phoneNumber.trim()
        if (trimmedName.isBlank() || trimmedNumber.isBlank()) return

        val currentMap = _settings.value.pinnedContacts.toMutableMap()
        currentMap[trimmedName] = trimmedNumber


        val json = JSONObject(currentMap as Map<*, *>)
        prefs.edit()
            .putString(KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS_MAP, json.toString())
            .apply()

        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(
            pinnedContacts = currentMap,
        )
    }

    fun removePinnedContact(name: String) {
        val trimmedName = name.trim()
        val currentMap = _settings.value.pinnedContacts.toMutableMap()
        val removedNumber = currentMap.remove(trimmedName)


        val json = JSONObject(currentMap as Map<*, *>)
        prefs.edit()
            .putString(KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS_MAP, json.toString())
            .apply()

        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(
            pinnedContacts = currentMap,
        )
    }

    fun togglePinnedContact(name: String, phoneNumber: String) {
        val current = _settings.value.pinnedContacts.toMutableMap()
        if (current.containsValue(phoneNumber)) {
            val key = current.entries.find { it.value == phoneNumber }?.key
            if (key != null) current.remove(key)
        } else {
            current[name] = phoneNumber
        }
        val json = JSONObject(current as Map<*, *>)
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS_MAP, json.toString()).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(pinnedContacts = current)
    }

    fun hideApp(packageName: String) {
        val current = _settings.value.hiddenApps.toMutableSet()
        current.add(packageName)
        prefs.edit().putStringSet(KEY_HIDDEN_APPS, current).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(hiddenApps = current)
    }

    fun unhideApp(packageName: String) {
        val current = _settings.value.hiddenApps.toMutableSet()
        current.remove(packageName)
        prefs.edit().putStringSet(KEY_HIDDEN_APPS, current).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(hiddenApps = current)
    }

    fun updateFontScale(scale: Float) {
        prefs.edit().putFloat(KEY_FONT_SCALE, scale).apply()
        _settings.value = _settings.value.copy(appFontScale = scale)
    }

    companion object {
        private const val KEY_THEME_MODE = "key_theme_mode"
        private const val KEY_WALLPAPER_SCRIM = "key_wallpaper_scrim"
        private const val KEY_HIDE_STATUS_BAR = "key_hide_status_bar"
        private const val KEY_CLOCK_VERT = "key_clock_vert"
        private const val KEY_CLOCK_HORIZ = "key_clock_horiz"
        private const val KEY_APPS_VERT = "key_apps_vert"
        private const val KEY_APPS_HORIZ = "key_apps_horiz"
        private const val KEY_ALIGNMENT = "key_alignment"
        private const val KEY_24_HOUR = "key_24_hour"
        private const val KEY_SHOW_DATE = "key_show_date"
        private const val KEY_SHOW_BATTERY = "key_show_battery"
        private const val KEY_SWIPE_LEFT = "key_swipe_left"
        private const val KEY_SWIPE_RIGHT = "key_swipe_right"
        private const val KEY_SWIPE_UP = "key_swipe_up"
        private const val KEY_SWIPE_DOWN = "key_swipe_down"
        private const val KEY_ALIASES = "key_aliases"
        private const val KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS = "key_pinned_contacts"
        private const val KEY_PINNED_CONTACTS_MAP = "key_pinned_contacts_map"
        private const val KEY_FONT_SCALE = "key_font_scale"
        private const val KEY_HIDDEN_APPS = "key_hidden_apps"
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.model

sealed interface GestureAction {
    data object OpenSearch : GestureAction
    data object OpenNotifications : GestureAction
    data object OpenQuickSettings : GestureAction
    data object OpenCamera : GestureAction
    data object OpenDialer : GestureAction
    data class LaunchApp(val packageName: String) : GestureAction
    data object None : GestureAction

    companion object {
        fun fromString(value: String): GestureAction {
            return when {
                value == "search" -> OpenSearch
                value == "notifications" -> OpenNotifications
                value == "quick_settings" -> OpenQuickSettings
                value == "camera" -> OpenCamera
                value == "dialer" -> OpenDialer
                value.startsWith("app:") -> LaunchApp(value.removePrefix("app:"))
                else -> None
            }
        }

        fun toString(action: GestureAction): String {
            return when (action) {
                is OpenSearch -> "search"
                is OpenNotifications -> "notifications"
                is OpenQuickSettings -> "quick_settings"
                is OpenCamera -> "camera"
                is OpenDialer -> "dialer"
                is LaunchApp -> "app:${action.packageName}"
                is None -> "none"
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.AppRepository
import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.SettingsRepository

class AliasSearchProvider(
    private val appRepository: AppRepository,
    private val settingsRepository: SettingsRepository
) : SearchProvider {

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val q = query.normalized
        val aliases = settingsRepository.settings.value.customAliases
        val apps = appRepository.installedApps.value
        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        for ((alias, target) in aliases) {
            val aliasMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, alias)
            if (aliasMatch.score > 0.0) {
                // Find matching app for target
                val targetApp = apps.find {
                    it.packageName.equals(target, ignoreCase = true) ||
                            it.label.equals(target, ignoreCase = true) ||
                            it.label.contains(target, ignoreCase = true)
                }

                if (targetApp != null) {
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "alias_${alias}_${targetApp.uniqueKey}",
                            title = targetApp.label,
                            subtitle = "Alias: $alias",
                            category = SearchCategory.ALIAS,
                            score = aliasMatch.score + 500.0, // High bonus so user aliases rank on top
                            action = SearchAction.LaunchApp(
                                packageName = targetApp.packageName,
                                activityName = targetApp.activityName,
                                userHandle = targetApp.userHandle
                            ),
                            badge = "Alias",
                            matchedRanges = listOf(0 until targetApp.label.length)
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        return results
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.AppRepository

class AppSearchProvider(
    private val appRepository: AppRepository
) : SearchProvider {

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val q = query.trimmed
        val allowFuzzy = q.length >= 3
        val apps = appRepository.installedApps.value

        return apps.mapNotNull { app ->
            val labelMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, app.label, allowFuzzy)
            val pkgMatch = if (labelMatch.score == 0.0 && q.length >= 2) {
                val shortPkg = app.packageName.substringAfterLast(".")
                if (shortPkg.startsWith(q, ignoreCase = true)) {
                    MatchResult(500.0, emptyList())
                } else null
            } else null

            val bestMatch = if (labelMatch.score > 0.0) labelMatch else pkgMatch

            if (bestMatch != null && bestMatch.score > 0.0) {
                SearchResult(
                    id = "app_${app.uniqueKey}",
                    title = app.label,
                    subtitle = null,
                    category = SearchCategory.APP,
                    score = bestMatch.score,
                    action = SearchAction.LaunchApp(
                        packageName = app.packageName,
                        activityName = app.activityName,
                        userHandle = app.userHandle
                    ),
                    badge = "App",
                    matchedRanges = bestMatch.matchedRanges
                )
            } else {
                null
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import android.provider.Settings

class CommandSearchProvider : SearchProvider {

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val verb = query.commandVerb ?: return emptyList()
        val arg = query.commandArg
        val trimmed = query.trimmed
        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        // 1. Bang / Web Search: "! weather" or "? what is 2+2" or "g search query"
        if (trimmed.startsWith("!") || trimmed.startsWith("?")) {
            val webQuery = trimmed.substring(1).trim()
            if (webQuery.isNotBlank()) {
                results.add(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "cmd_web_direct",
                        title = "Search Web: \"$webQuery\"",
                        subtitle = "Open in browser",
                        category = SearchCategory.WEB,
                        score = 2500.0,
                        action = SearchAction.OpenWebSearch(webQuery),
                        badge = "Web"
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        // 2. Timer command: "timer 20", "timer 5", "t 15"
        if (verb == "timer" || verb == "time" || (verb == "t" && arg.isNotBlank())) {
            val minutes = arg.filter { it.isDigit() }.toIntOrNull()
            if (minutes != null && minutes > 0) {
                results.add(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "cmd_timer_$minutes",
                        title = "Start Timer: $minutes min",
                        subtitle = "Starts a $minutes-minute countdown timer",
                        category = SearchCategory.COMMAND,
                        score = 2000.0,
                        action = SearchAction.SetTimer(minutes),
                        badge = "Command"
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        // 3. Alarm command: "alarm 500", "alarm 1830", "alarm 7", "alarm 7:30", "al 800"
        if (verb == "alarm" || verb == "al") {
            val parsedTime = parseAlarmTime(arg)
            if (parsedTime != null) {
                val (hour, minute) = parsedTime
                val formatted = String.format("%02d:%02d", hour, minute)
                results.add(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "cmd_alarm_${hour}_$minute",
                        title = "Set Alarm for $formatted",
                        subtitle = "Set an alarm at $formatted",
                        category = SearchCategory.COMMAND,
                        score = 2000.0,
                        action = SearchAction.SetAlarm(hour, minute),
                        badge = "Command"
                    )
                )
            }
        }



        if (verb == "bluetooth" || verb == "bt") {
            results.add(
                SearchResult(
                    id = "cmd_bluetooth",
                    title = "Open Bluetooth Settings",
                    subtitle = "Manage Bluetooth devices",
                    category = SearchCategory.COMMAND,
                    score = 1500.0,
                    action = SearchAction.OpenSystemSetting(Settings.ACTION_BLUETOOTH_SETTINGS, "Bluetooth"),
                    badge = "Quick Action"
                )
            )
        }

        // 5. Fallback Web Search option (at the bottom of all searches)
        if (!trimmed.startsWith("!") && !trimmed.startsWith("?")) {
            results.add(
                SearchResult(
                    id = "cmd_web_fallback",
                    title = "Search Web for \"$trimmed\"",
                    subtitle = "Search in default browser",
                    category = SearchCategory.WEB,
                    score = 20.0, // Low score so apps always rank higher
                    action = SearchAction.OpenWebSearch(trimmed),
                    badge = "Web"
                )
            )
        }

        return results
    }

    private fun parseAlarmTime(raw: String): Pair<Int, Int>? {
        val clean = raw.trim().lowercase()
        if (clean.isBlank()) return null
        
        val isPm = clean.contains("pm")
        val isAm = clean.contains("am")
        
        val digitsAndColon = clean.filter { it.isDigit() || it == ':' }

        // Format: "7:30", "18:45"
        if (digitsAndColon.contains(":")) {
            val parts = digitsAndColon.split(":")
            var h = parts[0].toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            val m = parts.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
            if (isPm && h < 12) h += 12
            if (isAm && h == 12) h = 0
            if (h in 0..23 && m in 0..59) {
                return Pair(h, m)
            }
        }

        val digits = digitsAndColon.filter { it.isDigit() }
        var h = -1
        var m = -1
        when (digits.length) {
            1, 2 -> {
                h = digits.toIntOrNull() ?: return null
                m = 0
            }
            3 -> {
                h = digits.substring(0, 1).toIntOrNull() ?: return null
                m = digits.substring(1).toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            }
            4 -> {
                h = digits.substring(0, 2).toIntOrNull() ?: return null
                m = digits.substring(2).toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            }
        }
        
        if (h != -1) {
            if (isPm && h < 12) h += 12
            if (isAm && h == 12) h = 0
            if (h in 0..23 && m in 0..59) return Pair(h, m)
        }

        return null
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import android.content.Context
import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.SettingsRepository
import com.pallas.launcher.platform.ContactsHelper

class ContactSearchProvider(
    private val context: Context,
    private val settingsRepository: SettingsRepository
) : SearchProvider {

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val settings = settingsRepository.settings.value
        val pinnedMap = settings.pinnedContacts // Name -> Phone Number
        val pinnedNumbers = settings.pinnedContacts.values.toSet()

        // If user hasn't selected any contacts, return empty (respects privacy & user settings)
        if (pinnedMap.isEmpty() && pinnedNumbers.isEmpty()) {
            return emptyList()
        }

        val candidateContacts = mutableListOf<com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ContactItem>()

        // 1. Add user-defined contacts from settings
        for ((name, number) in pinnedMap) {
            candidateContacts.add(
                com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ContactItem(
                    id = "pinned_${name}_${number}",
                    name = name,
                    phoneNumber = number
                )
            )
        }

        // 2. If READ_CONTACTS permission is available, merge matching contacts from device phonebook
        if (ContactsHelper.hasContactsPermission(context)) {
            val deviceContacts = ContactsHelper.getAllContacts(context)
            for (dc in deviceContacts) {
                val cleanDc = dc.phoneNumber.filter { it.isDigit() }
                val isSelected = pinnedNumbers.any { it.filter { c -> c.isDigit() } == cleanDc } ||
                        pinnedMap.values.any { it.filter { c -> c.isDigit() } == cleanDc }
                if (isSelected && candidateContacts.none { it.phoneNumber == dc.phoneNumber }) {
                    candidateContacts.add(dc)
                }
            }
        }

        if (candidateContacts.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()
        val verb = query.commandVerb
        val isCallCommand = verb == "call"
        val isSmsCommand = verb == "sms" || verb == "text" || verb == "msg"
        val isWaCommand = verb == "wa" || verb == "whatsapp"
        val searchTerm = if (isCallCommand || isSmsCommand || isWaCommand) query.commandArg else query.trimmed

        if (searchTerm.isBlank()) {
            if (isCallCommand || isSmsCommand || isWaCommand) {
                return candidateContacts.map { contact ->
                    val action = when {
                        isWaCommand -> SearchAction.WhatsAppChat(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name)
                        isSmsCommand -> SearchAction.SendSms(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name)
                        else -> SearchAction.DialContact(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name)
                    }
                    val badge = when {
                        isWaCommand -> "WhatsApp"
                        isSmsCommand -> "SMS"
                        else -> "Call"
                    }
                    val label = "$badge ${contact.name}"
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "contact_${contact.id}_cmd",
                        title = label,
                        subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                        category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                        score = 1200.0,
                        action = action,
                        badge = badge,
                        matchedRanges = listOf(0 until label.length)
                    )
                }
            }
            return emptyList()
        }

        for (contact in candidateContacts) {
            val match = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(searchTerm, contact.name)
            if (match.score > 0.0) {
                val baseScore = match.score + 250.0

                if (isCallCommand) {
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_call",
                            title = "Call ${contact.name}",
                            subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore + 600.0,
                            action = SearchAction.DialContact(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "Call",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                } else if (isSmsCommand) {
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_sms",
                            title = "SMS ${contact.name}",
                            subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore + 600.0,
                            action = SearchAction.SendSms(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "SMS",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                } else if (isWaCommand) {
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_wa",
                            title = "WhatsApp ${contact.name}",
                            subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore + 600.0,
                            action = SearchAction.WhatsAppChat(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "WhatsApp",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                } else {
                    // Regular contact search: Call as primary, SMS & WhatsApp as convenient options
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_call",
                            title = contact.name,
                            subtitle = "Call ${contact.phoneNumber}",
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore + 10.0,
                            action = SearchAction.DialContact(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "Call",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_sms",
                            title = "SMS ${contact.name}",
                            subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore,
                            action = SearchAction.SendSms(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "SMS",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                    results.add(
                        SearchResult(
                            id = "contact_${contact.id}_wa",
                            title = "WhatsApp ${contact.name}",
                            subtitle = contact.phoneNumber,
                            category = SearchCategory.CONTACT,
                            score = baseScore - 5.0,
                            action = SearchAction.WhatsAppChat(contact.phoneNumber, contact.name),
                            badge = "WhatsApp",
                            matchedRanges = match.matchedRanges
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        return results
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.ScreenRepository

class ScreenSearchProvider(
    private val screenRepository: ScreenRepository
) : SearchProvider {

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val q = query.normalized
        val screens = screenRepository.screens.value
        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        for ((index, screen) in screens.withIndex()) {
            val nameMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, screen.name)
            val screenWordMatch = if (q.startsWith("screen ") || q.startsWith("page ")) {
                val sub = q.substringAfter(" ")
                SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(sub, screen.name)
            } else null

            val bestMatch = if (screenWordMatch != null && screenWordMatch.score > 0.0) {
                MatchResult(screenWordMatch.score + 200.0, screenWordMatch.matchedRanges)
            } else if (nameMatch.score > 0.0) {
                nameMatch
            } else null

            if (bestMatch != null && bestMatch.score > 0.0) {
                results.add(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "screen_${screen.id}",
                        title = "${screen.name} Screen",
                        subtitle = "Switch to ${screen.apps.size} apps",
                        category = SearchCategory.SCREEN,
                        score = bestMatch.score + 100.0,
                        action = SearchAction.SwitchScreen(index),
                        badge = "Screen",
                        matchedRanges = bestMatch.matchedRanges
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        return results
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import com.pallas.launcher.data.repository.AppUsageTracker
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope

class SearchEngine(
    private val providers: List<SearchProvider>,
    private val appUsageTracker: AppUsageTracker? = null
) {
    suspend fun search(rawQuery: String): List<SearchResult> {
        val query = SearchQuery(rawQuery)
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        return kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Default) {
            val deferredList = providers.map { provider ->
                async {
                    try {
                        provider.search(query)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        emptyList()
                    }
                }
            }

            val allResults = deferredList.flatMap { it.await() }

            // Apply category prioritization so app suggestions always rank highest
            val scoredResults = allResults.map { result ->
                val categoryWeight = when (result.category) {
                    SearchCategory.APP -> 10000.0
                    SearchCategory.ALIAS -> 15000.0
                    SearchCategory.CONTACT -> 3000.0
                    SearchCategory.SHORTCUT -> 2000.0
                    SearchCategory.SYSTEM -> 1500.0
                    SearchCategory.SCREEN -> 1200.0
                    SearchCategory.COMMAND -> 500.0
                    SearchCategory.WEB -> 10.0
                }
                val usageBonus = if (result.category == SearchCategory.APP && result.action is SearchAction.LaunchApp && appUsageTracker != null) {
                    appUsageTracker.getUsageBonus(result.action.packageName)
                } else 0.0

                result.copy(score = result.score + categoryWeight + usageBonus)
            }

            val deduped = mutableMapOf<String, SearchResult>()
            for (res in scoredResults) {
                val dedupKey = when (val act = res.action) {
                    is SearchAction.LaunchApp -> "app_${act.packageName}_${act.userHandle?.hashCode()}"
                    else -> res.id
                }
                val existing = deduped[dedupKey]
                if (existing == null || res.score > existing.score) {
                    deduped[dedupKey] = res
                }
            }

            deduped.values
                .sortedByDescending { it.score }
                .take(30)
        }
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

data class SearchQuery(
    val raw: String
) {
    val trimmed: String = raw.trim()
    val normalized: String = trimmed.lowercase()
    val tokens: List<String> = normalized.split("\\s+".toRegex()).filter { it.isNotBlank() }

    val commandVerb: String? = tokens.firstOrNull()
    val commandArg: String = if (tokens.size > 1) trimmed.substringAfter(tokens[0]).trim() else ""

    fun isBlank(): Boolean = trimmed.isBlank()
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/pallas/launcher/domain/search/SearchRanking.kt
============================================================

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.util.Locale

data class MatchResult(
    val score: Double,
    val matchedRanges: List<IntRange> = emptyList()
)

object SearchRanking {

    private val DIACRITICS_REGEX = """\p{InCombiningDiacriticalMarks}+""".toRegex()
    private val CAMEL_CASE_1 = "(?<=[a-z])(?=[A-Z])".toRegex()
    private val CAMEL_CASE_2 = "(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])".toRegex()
    private val WORD_SPLIT = """[\s_\-.,:/]+""".toRegex()

    fun normalize(input: String): String {
        val nfd = Normalizer.normalize(input, Normalizer.Form.NFD)
        return nfd.replace(DIACRITICS_REGEX, "")
            .lowercase(Locale.getDefault())
    }

    fun extractWords(input: String): List<String> {
        val normalized = input.trim()
        if (normalized.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val withSpaces = normalized.replace(CAMEL_CASE_1, " ")
            .replace(CAMEL_CASE_2, " ")

        return withSpaces.split(WORD_SPLIT).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
    }

    fun evaluateMatch(query: String, target: String, allowFuzzy: Boolean = true): MatchResult {
        val qRaw = query.trim()
        val tRaw = target.trim()

        if (qRaw.isEmpty() || tRaw.isEmpty()) return MatchResult(0.0)

        val q = normalize(qRaw)
        val t = normalize(tRaw)

        // 1. Exact Match
        if (q == t) {
            return MatchResult(2000.0, listOf(0 until tRaw.length))
        }

        // 2. Exact Prefix Match
        if (t.startsWith(q)) {
            val ratio = q.length.toDouble() / t.length.toDouble()
            val score = 1500.0 + (ratio * 100.0)
            return MatchResult(score, listOf(0 until q.length))
        }

        // 3. Acronym / Initials Match (e.g. "wa" for "WhatsApp", "yt" for "YouTube", "calc" for "Calculator")
        val words = extractWords(tRaw)
        val acronymBuilder = StringBuilder()
        val wordStartIndices = mutableListOf<Int>()

        for (word in words) {
            val startIdx = t.indexOf(normalize(word))
            if (startIdx != -1) {
                acronymBuilder.append(word.first().lowercaseChar())
                wordStartIndices.add(startIdx)
            }
        }
        val acronym = acronymBuilder.toString()

        if (acronym.isNotEmpty() && acronym.startsWith(q)) {
            val matchedRanges = (0 until q.length).map { idx ->
                val charPos = wordStartIndices[idx]
                charPos..charPos
            }
            val score = 1300.0 + (q.length.toDouble() / acronym.length.toDouble() * 50.0)
            return MatchResult(score, matchedRanges)
        }

        // 4. Word-level Prefix Match
        // e.g. "calc" matches "Quick Calculator", "play" matches "Google Play"
        for (word in words) {
            val wordNorm = normalize(word)
            if (wordNorm.startsWith(q)) {
                val startIdx = t.indexOf(wordNorm)
                if (startIdx != -1) {
                    val ranges = listOf(startIdx until (startIdx + q.length))
                    val positionPenalty = startIdx * 2.0
                    val score = 1100.0 - positionPenalty + (q.length.toDouble() / wordNorm.length.toDouble() * 50.0)
                    return MatchResult(maxOf(score, 600.0), ranges)
                }
            }
        }

        // 5. Substring Match
        val substrIndex = t.indexOf(q)
        if (substrIndex != -1) {
            val ranges = listOf(substrIndex until (substrIndex + q.length))
            val score = 800.0 - (substrIndex * 4.0)
            return MatchResult(maxOf(score, 500.0), ranges)
        }

                if (!allowFuzzy) return MatchResult(0.0)

        // 6. Fuzzy Subsequence Match
        var qIdx = 0
        var tIdx = 0
        var consecutiveMatches = 0
        var scoreBonus = 0.0
        val matchedIndices = mutableListOf<Int>()

        while (qIdx < q.length && tIdx < t.length) {
            if (q[qIdx] == t[tIdx]) {
                matchedIndices.add(tIdx)

                // Word start bonus
                val isWordStart = tIdx == 0 || !t[tIdx - 1].isLetterOrDigit() ||
                        (tRaw[tIdx].isUpperCase() && (tIdx > 0 && !tRaw[tIdx - 1].isUpperCase()))

                if (isWordStart) {
                    scoreBonus += 30.0
                }

                // Consecutive match bonus
                scoreBonus += 15.0 + (consecutiveMatches * 10.0)
                consecutiveMatches++
                qIdx++
            } else {
                consecutiveMatches = 0
            }
            tIdx++
        }

        if (qIdx == q.length) {
            // All characters found in order
            val gapPenalty = (t.length - q.length) * 2.0
            val startPenalty = (matchedIndices.firstOrNull() ?: 0) * 3.0
            val totalScore = maxOf(50.0, 400.0 + scoreBonus - gapPenalty - startPenalty)

            // Consolidate continuous indices into ranges
            val ranges = consolidateRanges(matchedIndices)
            return MatchResult(totalScore, ranges)
        }

        return MatchResult(0.0)
    }

    private fun consolidateRanges(indices: List<Int>): List<IntRange> {
        if (indices.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val sorted = indices.sorted()
        val ranges = mutableListOf<IntRange>()
        var start = sorted[0]
        var prev = start

        for (i in 1 until sorted.size) {
            val curr = sorted[i]
            if (curr == prev + 1) {
                prev = curr
            } else {
                ranges.add(start..prev)
                start = curr
                prev = curr
            }
        }
        ranges.add(start..prev)
        return ranges
    }

    fun calculateMatchScore(query: String, target: String): Double {
        return evaluateMatch(query, target).score
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/pallas/launcher/domain/search/ShortcutSearchProvider.kt

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.LauncherApps
import android.content.pm.ShortcutInfo
import android.os.UserHandle
import android.os.UserManager

class ShortcutSearchProvider(
    private val context: Context
) : SearchProvider {

    private val packageManager = context.packageManager
    private val appLabelCache = mutableMapOf<String, String>()

    private fun getAppLabel(packageName: String): String {
        return appLabelCache.getOrPut(packageName) {
            runCatching {
                val ai = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
                packageManager.getApplicationLabel(ai).toString()
            }.getOrDefault(packageName)
        }
    }

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val launcherApps = context.getSystemService(Context.LAUNCHER_APPS_SERVICE) as? LauncherApps ?: return emptyList()
        val userManager = context.getSystemService(Context.USER_SERVICE) as? UserManager ?: return emptyList()

        val hasHostPermission = runCatching { launcherApps.hasShortcutHostPermission() }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!hasHostPermission) return emptyList()

        val q = query.trimmed
        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        try {
            val shortcutQuery = LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery().apply {
                setQueryFlags(
                    LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_DYNAMIC or
                            LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_PINNED or
                            LauncherApps.ShortcutQuery.FLAG_MATCH_MANIFEST
                )
            }

            for (profile in userManager.userProfiles) {
                val shortcuts = runCatching { launcherApps.getShortcuts(shortcutQuery, profile) }.getOrNull() ?: continue
                for (shortcut in shortcuts) {
                    if (!shortcut.isEnabled) continue

                    val shortLabel = shortcut.shortLabel?.toString()
                    val longLabel = shortcut.longLabel?.toString()
                    val displayLabel = shortLabel ?: longLabel ?: shortcut.id

                    val labelMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, displayLabel, allowFuzzy = q.length >= 3)
                    val longMatch = if (longLabel != null && longLabel != shortLabel) {
                        SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, longLabel, allowFuzzy = q.length >= 3)
                    } else null

                    val bestMatch = if (longMatch != null && longMatch.score > labelMatch.score) longMatch else labelMatch

                    if (bestMatch.score > 0.0) {
                        val pkgName = shortcut.`package`
                        val appLabel = getAppLabel(pkgName)
                        results.add(
                            SearchResult(
                                id = "shortcut_${pkgName}_${shortcut.id}",
                                title = displayLabel,
                                subtitle = appLabel,
                                category = SearchCategory.SHORTCUT,
                                score = bestMatch.score + 50.0,
                                action = SearchAction.LaunchShortcut(
                                    packageName = pkgName,
                                    shortcutId = shortcut.id,
                                    userHandle = profile
                                ),
                                badge = "Shortcut",
                                matchedRanges = bestMatch.matchedRanges
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        return results
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.domain.search

import android.content.Intent
import android.provider.Settings

class SystemActionSearchProvider : SearchProvider {

    private sealed interface ActionTarget {
        data class OpenIntent(val action: String) : ActionTarget
        data object ToggleTorch : ActionTarget
        data object ExpandQuickSettings : ActionTarget
    }

    private data class SystemActionEntry(

            label = "Hotspot & Tethering",
            keywords = listOf("hotspot", "tethering", "portable hotspot", "wifi hotspot", "share internet"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_WIRELESS_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_sound",
            label = "Sound & Vibration",
            keywords = listOf("sound", "volume", "audio", "vibration", "settings sound", "ringtone", "mute"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_SOUND_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_battery",
            label = "Battery & Power",
            keywords = listOf("battery", "power", "battery saver", "settings battery"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_BATTERY_SAVER_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_airplane",
            label = "Airplane Mode",
            keywords = listOf("airplane", "flight mode", "settings airplane"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_AIRPLANE_MODE_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_apps",
            label = "App Management",
            keywords = listOf("apps", "applications", "installed apps", "settings apps"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_storage",
            label = "Storage Settings",
            keywords = listOf("storage", "memory", "internal storage", "disk", "settings storage"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_INTERNAL_STORAGE_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_datetime",
            label = "Date & Time",
            keywords = listOf("date", "time", "clock settings", "timezone", "settings time"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_DATE_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_security",
            label = "Security & Privacy",
            keywords = listOf("security", "privacy", "lock screen", "fingerprint", "passwords"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_SECURITY_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_home",
            label = "Default Home App",
            keywords = listOf("default launcher", "home settings", "launcher settings"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Settings.ACTION_HOME_SETTINGS)
        ),
        SystemActionEntry(
            key = "sys_wallpaper",
            label = "Change Wallpaper",
            keywords = listOf("wallpaper", "background", "wallpapers"),
            target = ActionTarget.OpenIntent(Intent.ACTION_SET_WALLPAPER)
        )
    )

    override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val q = query.normalized
        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        for (entry in entries) {
            val labelMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, entry.label)
            var bestMatch = labelMatch

            for (keyword in entry.keywords) {
                val kwMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch(q, keyword)
                if (kwMatch.score > bestMatch.score) {
                    bestMatch = kwMatch
                }
            }

            if (bestMatch.score > 0.0) {
                val action = when (val target = entry.target) {
                    is ActionTarget.OpenIntent -> SearchAction.OpenSystemSetting(target.action, entry.label)
                    is ActionTarget.ToggleTorch -> SearchAction.ToggleTorch
                    is ActionTarget.ExpandQuickSettings -> SearchAction.ExpandQuickSettings
                }

                results.add(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = entry.key,
                        title = entry.label,
                        subtitle = "System Action",
                        category = SearchCategory.SYSTEM,
                        score = bestMatch.score,
                        action = action,
                        badge = "System",
                        matchedRanges = if (bestMatch === labelMatch) bestMatch.matchedRanges else emptyList()
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        return results
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.activity.addCallback
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge
import androidx.activity.viewModels
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.runtime.collectAsState
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import com.pallas.launcher.ui.MainViewModel
import com.pallas.launcher.ui.home.PallasHomeScreen
import com.pallas.launcher.ui.theme.PallasLauncherTheme

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    private val viewModel: MainViewModel by viewModels()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        enableEdgeToEdge()

        onBackPressedDispatcher.addCallback(this) {
            if (viewModel.isAppDrawerOpen.value) {
                viewModel.setAppDrawerOpen(false)
            } else if (viewModel.isSearchActive.value) {
                viewModel.setSearchActive(false)
            } else if (viewModel.isSettingsOpen.value) {
                viewModel.closeSettings()
            } else if (viewModel.isScreenEditorOpen.value) {
                viewModel.closeScreenEditor()
            } else if (viewModel.isAppPickerOpen.value) {
                viewModel.closeAppPicker()
            } else if (viewModel.appToCustomize.value != null) {
                viewModel.setAppToCustomize(null)
            } else {
                // If on secondary screen, go to home screen (screen 0)
                if (viewModel.currentScreenIndex.value != 0) {
                    viewModel.setScreenIndex(0)
                }
            }
        }

        setContent {
            val settings by viewModel.settings.collectAsState()
            
            val isDark = when (settings.themeMode) {
                com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.DARK -> true
                com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.LIGHT -> false
                com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.SYSTEM -> androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme()
            }
            
            androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(isDark) {
                val style = if (isDark) androidx.activity.SystemBarStyle.dark(android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT) else androidx.activity.SystemBarStyle.light(android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT, android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT)
                enableEdgeToEdge(statusBarStyle = style, navigationBarStyle = style)
            }

            androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(settings.hideStatusBar) {
                val insetsController = androidx.core.view.WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, window.decorView)
                if (settings.hideStatusBar) {
                    insetsController.hide(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
                } else {
                    insetsController.show(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
                }
            }

            PallasLauncherTheme(themeMode = settings.themeMode) {
                Surface(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    color = Color.Transparent
                ) {
                    PallasHomeScreen(viewModel = viewModel)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        // Home button pressed
        viewModel.resetToHomeScreen()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        // No need to reloadApps, the callback covers this
        
        val settings = viewModel.settings.value
        val insetsController = androidx.core.view.WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, window.decorView)
        insetsController.systemBarsBehavior = androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        if (settings.hideStatusBar) {
            insetsController.hide(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
        } else {
            insetsController.show(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
        }
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.platform

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.os.BatteryManager

object BatteryManagerHelper {

    fun getBatteryPercentage(context: Context): Int {
        val filter = IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED)
        val batteryStatus: Intent? = context.registerReceiver(null, filter)
        val level: Int = batteryStatus?.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1) ?: -1
        val scale: Int = batteryStatus?.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, -1) ?: -1
        return if (level >= 0 && scale > 0) {
            (level * 100 / scale)
        } else {
            -1
        }
    }
}

package com.pallas.launcher.platform

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.database.Cursor
import android.provider.ContactsContract
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ContactItem

object ContactsHelper {

    fun hasContactsPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            context,
            android.Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    fun getAllContacts(context: Context): List<ContactItem> {
        if (!hasContactsPermission(context)) return emptyList()

        val contactList = mutableListOf<ContactItem>()
        val uri = ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTENT_URI
        val projection = arrayOf(
            ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTACT_ID,
            ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.DISPLAY_NAME,
            ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.NUMBER
        )
        val sortOrder = "${ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.DISPLAY_NAME} ASC"

        try {
            val cursor: Cursor? = context.contentResolver.query(
                uri,
                projection,
                null,
                null,
                sortOrder
            )

            cursor?.use {
                val idCol = it.getColumnIndex(ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTACT_ID)
                val nameCol = it.getColumnIndex(ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.DISPLAY_NAME)
                val numberCol = it.getColumnIndex(ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.NUMBER)

                val seenNumbers = mutableSetOf<String>()
                while (it.moveToNext()) {
                    val id = if (idCol >= 0) it.getString(idCol) ?: "" else ""
                    val name = if (nameCol >= 0) it.getString(nameCol) ?: "" else ""
                    val number = if (numberCol >= 0) it.getString(numberCol) ?: "" else ""
                    val cleanNumber = number.replace("[\\s\\-\\(\\)]".toRegex(), "")

                    if (name.isNotBlank() && cleanNumber.isNotBlank() && seenNumbers.add(cleanNumber)) {
                        contactList.add(ContactItem(id = id, name = name, phoneNumber = number))
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        return contactList
    }
}
