package com.pallas.launcher

import com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.HomeScreen
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.CommandSearchProvider
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SystemActionSearchProvider
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.ScreenSearchProvider
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchAction
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchCategory
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchQuery
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchRanking
import com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchResult
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SearchTests {

    @Test
    fun testExactMatchScoresHighest() {
        val exactMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("camera", "Camera")
        val prefixMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("cam", "Camera")
        assertTrue("Exact score should be higher than prefix", exactMatch.score > prefixMatch.score)
        assertTrue("Exact score should be around 2000", exactMatch.score >= 2000.0)
        assertFalse("Matched ranges should not be empty", exactMatch.matchedRanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testAcronymAndInitialsMatching() {
        val waMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("wa", "WhatsApp")
        val ytMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("yt", "YouTube")
        val calcMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("calc", "Calculator")

        assertTrue("wa should match WhatsApp", waMatch.score > 0.0)
        assertTrue("yt should match YouTube", ytMatch.score > 0.0)
        assertTrue("calc should match Calculator", calcMatch.score > 0.0)

        // Matched ranges should highlight the acronym characters
        assertFalse(waMatch.matchedRanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testWordExtractionCamelCase() {
        val wordsWA = SearchRanking.extractWords("WhatsApp")
        assertEquals(listOf("Whats", "App"), wordsWA)

        val wordsYT = SearchRanking.extractWords("YouTube")
        assertEquals(listOf("You", "Tube"), wordsYT)

        val wordsPlay = SearchRanking.extractWords("Google Play Store")
        assertEquals(listOf("Google", "Play", "Store"), wordsPlay)
    }

    @Test
    fun testDiacriticsNormalization() {
        val cafeMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("cafe", "Café")
        assertTrue("cafe should match Café", cafeMatch.score >= 1500.0)

        val uberMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("uber", "Über")
        assertTrue("uber should match Über", uberMatch.score >= 1500.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCommandTimer() = runBlocking {
        val provider = CommandSearchProvider()
        val results = provider.search(SearchQuery("timer 20"))
        val first = results.first { it.category == SearchCategory.COMMAND }
        assertTrue(first.title.contains("20 min"))
        val action = first.action as SearchAction.SetTimer
        assertEquals(20, action.durationMinutes)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCommandAlarm() = runBlocking {
        val provider = CommandSearchProvider()

        // 5:00 AM test
        val res500 = provider.search(SearchQuery("alarm 500"))
        val action500 = res500.first { it.category == SearchCategory.COMMAND }.action as SearchAction.SetAlarm
        assertEquals(5, action500.hour)
        assertEquals(0, action500.minute)

        // 18:30 / 6:30 PM test
        val res1830 = provider.search(SearchQuery("alarm 1830"))
        val action1830 = res1830.first { it.category == SearchCategory.COMMAND }.action as SearchAction.SetAlarm
        assertEquals(18, action1830.hour)
        assertEquals(30, action1830.minute)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCommandQuickToggles() = runBlocking {
        val provider = SystemActionSearchProvider()
        val wifiResults = provider.search(SearchQuery("wifi"))
        assertTrue(wifiResults.any { it.title.contains("Wi-Fi") })

        val btResults = provider.search(SearchQuery("bluetooth"))
        assertTrue(btResults.any { it.title.contains("Bluetooth") })
    }

    @Test
    fun testBangWebSearch() = runBlocking {
        val provider = CommandSearchProvider()
        val results = provider.search(SearchQuery("! android compose"))
        val top = results.first()
        assertEquals(SearchCategory.WEB, top.category)
        assertTrue(top.title.contains("android compose"))
        val action = top.action as SearchAction.OpenWebSearch
        assertEquals("android compose", action.query)
    }

    @Test
    fun testScreenSearch() = runBlocking {
        val mockScreenRepo = object {
            val screens: StateFlow<List<HomeScreen>> = MutableStateFlow(
                listOf(
                    HomeScreen(id = "1", name = "Home", contextTag = "Default"),
                    HomeScreen(id = "2", name = "Work", contextTag = "Professional"),
                    HomeScreen(id = "3", name = "Finance", contextTag = "Money")
                )
            )
        }

        // Search "work" directly
        val matchWork = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("work", "Work")
        assertTrue("Should match Work screen", matchWork.score > 0.0)

        // Search "finance" directly
        val matchFinance = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("fin", "Finance")
        assertTrue("Should prefix match Finance screen", matchFinance.score > 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSystemActionTorch() = runBlocking {
        val provider = com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SystemActionSearchProvider()
        val resultsTorch = provider.search(SearchQuery("torch"))
        assertTrue("torch query should yield Flashlight", resultsTorch.any { it.action is SearchAction.ToggleTorch })

        val resultsFlash = provider.search(SearchQuery("flashlight"))
        assertTrue("flashlight query should yield Flashlight", resultsFlash.any { it.action is SearchAction.ToggleTorch })
    }

    @Test
    fun testSystemActionDisplaySettings() = runBlocking {
        val provider = com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SystemActionSearchProvider()
        val results = provider.search(SearchQuery("settings display"))
        assertTrue("settings display should yield Display Settings", results.any { it.title.contains("Display") })
        val settingAction = results.first { it.title.contains("Display") }.action as SearchAction.OpenSystemSetting
        assertEquals(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_DISPLAY_SETTINGS, settingAction.actionIntent)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSystemActionQuickSettings() = runBlocking {
        val provider = com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SystemActionSearchProvider()
        val results = provider.search(SearchQuery("quick settings"))
        assertTrue("quick settings query should yield Quick Settings action", results.any { it.action is SearchAction.ExpandQuickSettings })
    }

    @Test
    fun testShortcutRankingEvaluation() {
        val matchIncognito = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("incog", "New Incognito Tab")
        assertTrue("incog should match New Incognito Tab", matchIncognito.score > 0.0)

        val matchSub = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("subs", "Subscriptions")
        assertTrue("subs should match Subscriptions", matchSub.score > 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun testLauncherSettingsDefaultsAndPositions() {
        val defaultSettings = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.LauncherSettings()
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.DARK, defaultSettings.themeMode)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockVerticalPosition.TOP, defaultSettings.clockVerticalPosition)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT, defaultSettings.clockHorizontalAlignment)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsVerticalPosition.BOTTOM, defaultSettings.appsVerticalPosition)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsHorizontalAlignment.RIGHT, defaultSettings.appsHorizontalAlignment)
        assertFalse(defaultSettings.showWallpaperScrim)
        assertFalse(defaultSettings.hideStatusBar)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCustomPositionsConfiguration() {
        val customSettings = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.LauncherSettings(
            themeMode = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.LIGHT,
            clockVerticalPosition = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockVerticalPosition.BOTTOM,
            clockHorizontalAlignment = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockHorizontalAlignment.LEFT,
            appsVerticalPosition = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsVerticalPosition.CENTER,
            appsHorizontalAlignment = com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsHorizontalAlignment.CENTER,
            showWallpaperScrim = true,
            hideStatusBar = true
        )

        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ThemeMode.LIGHT, customSettings.themeMode)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockVerticalPosition.BOTTOM, customSettings.clockVerticalPosition)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.ClockHorizontalAlignment.LEFT, customSettings.clockHorizontalAlignment)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsVerticalPosition.CENTER, customSettings.appsVerticalPosition)
        assertEquals(com.pallas.launcher.domain.model.AppsHorizontalAlignment.CENTER, customSettings.appsHorizontalAlignment)
        assertTrue(customSettings.showWallpaperScrim)
        assertTrue(customSettings.hideStatusBar)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAppCategoryAlwaysRanksHighest() = runBlocking {
        val appProvider = object : com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchProvider {
            override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchResult> {
                return listOf(
                    com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchResult(
                        id = "app_calc",
                        title = "Calculator",
                        category = SearchCategory.APP,
                        score = 1500.0,
                        action = SearchAction.OpenWebSearch("calc")
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        val cmdProvider = object : com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchProvider {
            override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchResult> {
                return listOf(
                    com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchResult(
                        id = "cmd_calc",
                        title = "Calculator Command",
                        category = SearchCategory.COMMAND,
                        score = 2000.0,
                        action = SearchAction.OpenWebSearch("cmd")
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        val engine = com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchEngine(
            providers = listOf(cmdProvider, appProvider)
        )

        val results = engine.search("calc")
        assertEquals("App should rank first over command despite raw score", "app_calc", results.first().id)
        assertEquals(SearchCategory.APP, results.first().category)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAlphabeticalFrequencySorting() {
        data class TestApp(val name: String, val launchCount: Int)
        val apps = listOf(
            TestApp("Camera", 2),
            TestApp("Chrome", 15),
            TestApp("Calendar", 5),
            TestApp("Calculator", 15)
        )

        val sorted = apps.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<TestApp> { it.launchCount }.thenBy { it.name.lowercase() }
        )

        // Calculator (15) and Chrome (15) should be top, with Calculator first alphabetically
        assertEquals("Calculator", sorted[0].name)
        assertEquals("Chrome", sorted[1].name)
        assertEquals("Calendar", sorted[2].name)
        assertEquals("Camera", sorted[3].name)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAliasRanksAboveAppAndDedupes() = runBlocking {
        val appProvider = object : com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchProvider {
            override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
                return listOf(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "app_waze",
                        title = "Waze",
                        category = SearchCategory.APP,
                        score = 1550.0,
                        action = SearchAction.LaunchApp("com.waze", "MainActivity")
                    ),
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "app_whatsapp",
                        title = "WhatsApp",
                        category = SearchCategory.APP,
                        score = 1525.0,
                        action = SearchAction.LaunchApp("com.whatsapp", "MainActivity")
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        val aliasProvider = object : com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchProvider {
            override suspend fun search(query: SearchQuery): List<SearchResult> {
                return listOf(
                    SearchResult(
                        id = "alias_wa",
                        title = "WhatsApp",
                        subtitle = "Alias for 'wa'",
                        category = SearchCategory.ALIAS,
                        score = 2500.0,
                        action = SearchAction.LaunchApp("com.whatsapp", "MainActivity")
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        val engine = com.pallas.launcher.domain.search.SearchEngine(
            providers = listOf(appProvider, aliasProvider)
        )

        val results = engine.search("wa")
        assertEquals(2, results.size)
        // Alias should be top result
        assertEquals(SearchCategory.ALIAS, results[0].category)
        assertEquals("WhatsApp", results[0].title)
        // Deduplicated: WhatsApp only appears once as the alias hit
        assertFalse(results.any { it.id == "app_whatsapp" })
        // Second result is Waze
        assertEquals("Waze", results[1].title)
    }

    @Test
    fun testFuzzyMatchingRequiresAtLeastThreeCharacters() {
        val twoCharMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("cm", "Camera", allowFuzzy = false)
        assertEquals(0.0, twoCharMatch.score, 0.01)

        val threeCharMatch = SearchRanking.evaluateMatch("cmr", "Camera", allowFuzzy = true)
        assertTrue(threeCharMatch.score > 0.0)
    }
}
